purpose: Evaluate parsimonious monetary-transmission candidates under prospective calibration, structural-selection and holdout rules without reusing previously inspected evaluation data.

candidate_models.interpretation: Immediate monthly pass-through in changes without intercept.
One-month delayed pass-through in changes without intercept.
Parsimonious mean-spread anchor plus one adjustment-speed parameter; simpler than Alpha 0.5's free alpha/beta/lambda form.
Static level relationship used as a deliberately simple comparator; not interpreted causally.

estimation.calibration: Fit on 2017-08..2022-12 only for calibration diagnostics.
estimation.structural_selection: Expanding-origin one-step predictions over 2023-01..2025-01. At each origin only observations strictly earlier than the target month may be used to fit parameters.
estimation.final_evaluation: 2025-02..2025-11 may be opened only if at least one candidate passes every structural-selection gate. A failed selection result cannot be rescued by final evaluation.
estimation.future_confirmation: MIR observations from 2026-08 onward remain prospectively reserved regardless of the current result.

structural_selection_gates.rule: A candidate passes only if every gate passes for the target. Selection is target-specific; success for one target does not validate the other.

final_holdout_gates_if_opened.sensitivity: ±10% perturbation of each free parameter must not more than double RMSE relative to the unperturbed candidate.

verdict_rules.VALIDATED: Target mechanism passes identifiability, structural selection, final holdout and sensitivity gates. This supports reference predictive use within the tested boundary, not causal identification.
verdict_rules.CANDIDATE: Evidence supports the mechanism but predictive/identifiability gates are incomplete or failed without a structural contradiction.
verdict_rules.DEFERRED: Required observables or boundary-matched parameters are unavailable.
verdict_rules.REJECTED: The tested form fails decisively or is structurally invalid; mechanism existence may still be reconsidered only with a newly preregistered form/data cycle.
